who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), write-only lane E3 under rebuild-1115
what: A call written inside an expansion carries its input as `&str`, a slice of the rendered text, and the outline that finds the call is the rendered text outlined. To take the input as tokens, I have to map the slice's bytes back to stream tokens through the renderer's byte places. Calls in a text rewritten after rendering (statements read as items, a block's module) have no places, so they still lex their inputs from text. The lane also had no Grep or Glob tool, so all searching went through the REPL's rg.
cost: about an hour working out the places and words mapping, and a byte-offset bridge where an index should be
cause: the outline and CallSrc address calls by text, and the text is the only thing they share with the tokens
whys: blaze-file-items outlines text; the expansion is rendered to text for it; nothing outlines the token record yet (piece 3 of E3)
class: a second address space (bytes of a rendered text) kept beside the tokens, joined by offsets
prevention: outline the expansion's token record directly (blaze_file_items over blaze-tokens) so a call's input is a TokenRange; then the places and words bridge and offset_in go
workaround: ExpansionTokens::input maps input bytes to a token range using the renderer's places, and refuses by name (NestedInputError) when it cannot
